capabilities: Relay WeChat text and images into a live Claudian session and stream responses back
Switch, list, and create Claudian sessions remotely via /ls, /goto, and /new
Run slash commands and change model, effort, and permission settings from WeChat
Mirror desktop Claudian turns to WeChat with /listen
Bootstrap and manage a local Python relay process with QR-code WeChat login
extras: Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Requires desktop Obsidian, Python 3.11+ on PATH, and Claudian configured with a working provider; the bundled relay.py runs in an auto-created virtualenv and all traffic stays on 127.0.0.1.
intentEvidence: Remote control your Claudian AI coding agent inside Obsidian directly from WeChat
problem: Claudian's AI agent only runs in the desktop Obsidian window, so there is no way to prompt it, send it images, or switch sessions while away from the computer.

relations.evidence: Claudian by Yishen Tu — The core Obsidian agent plugin driven by this bridge.
wechat-clawbot by nightsailer (Pan Fan) — Python WeChat ClawBot iLink API client foundation.

summary: Bridge that relays WeChat messages, images and slash commands into a Claudian AI coding agent session inside Obsidian and returns its responses.
